headline: Action Comics #1107 splits Lex Luthor
post:
That infamous late '90s electric Superman era is getting a clever nod! According to Screen Rant, Ryan Sook's variant cover for Action Comics #1107 features a striking homage to the classic 1998 Superman Red and Superman Blue split.

The artwork showcases two versions of Lex Luthor looking skyward with crackling energy. One Lex wears all purple while the other is covered head to toe in green, halving the villain based on his famous battlesuit colors. While the solicitation doesn't state if Luthor actually divides in two within the issue itself, the cover brilliantly mirrors Ron Frenz's historic artwork.

That legendary storyline always sparked major debate. Some readers viewed it as pure hype to boost sales, while others embraced the nostalgic Silver Age tribute. Will you be grabbing this variant cover when it releases on February 10? ⚡

#Superman #LexLuthor #DCComics
original_title: Superman's Most Controversial Redesign Of All Time Returns With New Twist

headline: Emperor Aquaman #26 reveals Old Man Aquaman
post:
DC Comics is shaking things up for the King of Atlantis with a striking makeover. According to Screen Rant, the upcoming "Desert World" arc sends Arthur Curry to an apocalyptic future where Earth is "dried to the core". 

During this harrowing journey, he will cross paths with an older variant nicknamed "Old Man Aquaman". This grizzled future version sports a rugged aesthetic that channels classic '90s vibes alongside live-action cinematic styling. Meanwhile, variant covers hint that Black Manta will also appear in this desolate timeline. 

Beyond the stunning visual overhaul, this issue connects directly to looming threats from Darkseid following the DC K.O. event. Will Arthur manage to escape this wasteland and stop the oncoming catastrophe? 🌊

#Aquaman #DCComics #OldManAquaman
original_title: DC Releases Bold New Aquaman Design, All Details
